description: Every data file the app and API serve, with SHA-256 checksums. Verify a download with: sha256sum <file>.

datasets.title: LOLA south-polar terrain, 240 m
datasets.source: LRO LOLA RDR via USGS Astrogeology ARD (s3://astrogeo-ard/moon/lro/lola/)
datasets.frame: south-polar stereographic on the 1737.4 km sphere, metres
datasets.units: int16 little-endian, heights in metres above the 1737.4 km LOLA reference sphere
datasets.licence: NASA data: no US copyright (public domain); credit the source
datasets.limitations: Interpolated between LOLA tracks; crests smoothed by tens of metres.
datasets.crs: Moon body-fixed (IAU rotation model, mean Earth / polar axis), planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude
datasets.verticalDatum: heights above the 1737.4 km reference sphere (metres)

datasets.title: LOLA south-polar terrain, 1 km
datasets.source: LRO LOLA RDR via USGS Astrogeology ARD (s3://astrogeo-ard/moon/lro/lola/)

datasets.frame: south-polar stereographic on the 1737.4 km sphere, metres
datasets.units: int16 little-endian, heights in metres above the 1737.4 km LOLA reference sphere
datasets.licence: NASA data: no US copyright (public domain); credit the source
datasets.limitations: Used beyond the 240 m grid only.
datasets.crs: Moon body-fixed (IAU rotation model, mean Earth / polar axis), planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude
datasets.verticalDatum: heights above the 1737.4 km reference sphere (metres)

datasets.title: LOLA whole-Moon terrain
datasets.source: NASA LRO LOLA global elevation map LDEM_16 (PDS Geosciences Node), block-averaged to 8 px/deg
datasets.frame: equirectangular, 8 pixels per degree, east-positive longitude
datasets.units: int16 little-endian, heights in metres above the 1737.4 km LOLA reference sphere
datasets.licence: NASA data: no US copyright (public domain); credit the source
datasets.limitations: Block-averaged; site skylines north of 80° S are built from the full LDEM_16 (1.9 km) in CI instead.
datasets.crs: Moon body-fixed (IAU rotation model, mean Earth / polar axis), planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude
datasets.verticalDatum: heights above the 1737.4 km reference sphere (metres)

datasets.title: LOLA 20 m tiles: Artemis III candidate regions and south-polar sites
datasets.source: NASA GSFC PGDA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ (Barker et al. 2023) (https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/products/90)
datasets.coverage: 65 tiles of 16 × 16 km covering the Artemis III candidate regions CB, G2, HW, MA, MM, MP, N1, N2, SP; 313 more around other south-polar sites
datasets.frame: south-polar stereographic on the 1737.4 km sphere, metres
datasets.units: int16, heights in metres above the 1737.4 km LOLA reference sphere; packed losslessly (src/core/tileCodec.js: difference from the row above, gzip)
datasets.generator: tools/build_hires_terrain.mjs (Add 20 m terrain and check against NASA PGDA workflow)
datasets.licence: NASA data: no US copyright (public domain); credit the source
datasets.limitations: Each tile checked against the 240 m grid: mean height difference 1.7–23.9 m; tiles failing a 60 m check (100 m against the 1 km grid) are rejected.
datasets.crs: Moon body-fixed (IAU rotation model, mean Earth / polar axis), planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude
datasets.verticalDatum: heights above the 1737.4 km reference sphere (metres)

datasets.title: Sunlight and Earth-visibility map layers, 2027
datasets.source: NASA LRO LOLA: 240 m / 1 km south-polar grids and the LDEM_16-based global grid (8 px/deg)
datasets.coverage: whole Moon (1°) and both polar caps (5 km)
datasets.licence: MIT (this project), derived from NASA data
datasets.limitations: Skyline in 72 directions (5° apart) with the app ray-caster; 6-hour sampling; disk centre, not disk fraction.

datasets.verticalDatum: heights above the 1737.4 km reference sphere (metres)
